name: Parkrestaurant & Cafe
kurzbeschreibung:
**Outdoor Dining & Café in Krün**

Enjoy fresh mountain air and stunning views of the **Zugspitze** and **Karwendel** at our **Parkrestaurant & Café** in **Krün**. Savor traditional Tyrolean dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Käsespätzle**, and crispy **Schweinsbraten**, paired with local **Tiroler Bier** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle**.

Perfect for a relaxed break after a hike or a cozy stop before exploring **Innsbruck** or the **Karwendel region**. Our terrace invites you to unwind with a coffee, a slice of **Apfelstrudel**, or a cold **Radler** while soaking in the breathtaking scenery.

Open year-round—whether you're skiing in winter or hiking in summer, we’re your sunny spot in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**.
